independent_review.reviewer: Separate verification pass by the same assistant; no additional agents
checks: Recomputed 21 eligible physical nodes and 14 eligible idle nodes from the supplied inventory and all 15 exclusions.
Compared coarse/fine definitions: only branch filenames, spatial half-step, and equal-extent point budgets differ.
Bound release to matching finished source jobs, accepted parent checkpoint, one-imaginary-mode harmonic spectrum and original staged scientific files.
Refused earlier attempts, duplicate settings under an alias, changed model/input/Hessian, live or mismatched source jobs, and one-point stopping.
Exercised real owner admission through the real shared policy: seven retained jobs plus fourteen new jobs reach 21; eight remaining tasks backfill after completion; two early-stop tasks remain held.
Exercised the five-decision chain, native-worker success/failure receipts, queue-live adoption delay, fair backfilling, unchanged source files and repeated prepare/refresh/capacity calls.
Exercised refresh submission/staging/archive/ownership/scheduler races before retiring the Python owner.
Checked duplicate and malformed node rows, unavailable node flags, resource floors, preserved exclusions, scheduler failures, concurrent policy changes and repeated capacity application.
Verified read-only watcher and bounded evidence export include sampling decisions and capacity receipts.
Confirmed the published file set excludes unrelated workspace modifications.
